novelty_search.coverage: Session 11. Collins (1989) read in full and Collins's thesis (1986) read (page images for pp. 30–47 and 55–61, OCR for the rest): neither contains any of the items. Literature audit by a separate agent context (11 web searches, 19 fetches; queries and URLs verbatim in the dossier): arXiv listings, Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex citation lists of arXiv:1507.02341, Mohar's 2007 preprint on Laplacian coefficients of acyclic graphs (read in full) and Csikvári, On a poset of trees II (pp. 1–11 and 19–21 read). Earlier audits of sessions 9 and 10 searched for coefficientwise extremality of the star and for bounds on the peak. Within this coverage no prior proof of the lower bound ⌊n/2⌋ for every tree, no coefficientwise extremal result for the distance characteristic polynomial of trees, and no monotonicity of its coefficients under a tree shift was found.
novelty_search.limitations: Shallow. Not searched: MathSciNet, zbMATH, Google Scholar; MathOverflow, OEIS and the formal libraries only by one general query or not at all. Not read: Graham–Lovász (1978) pp. 72–88, Csikvári's first paper (Combinatorica 2010) and pp. 12–18 of the second, Guo (2010), Stevanović–Ilić and the literature on the distance spectral radius of trees, 'The 2-Steiner distance matrix of a tree' (2022) and 'On a poset of trees revisited' (2021) (titles only), the mathematical-chemistry journals. The intermediate statements (S32 to S35, the polynomial E) were not searched. English only. An unsuccessful search does not establish originality.
